active.goal: Turn Celine into a stable, room-anchored, naturally moving human-like videochat presence with real close zoom and temporal real-device acceptance.

evidence: The real camera scale grows at each checkpoint: peakRow 129 -> 158 -> 194.
The strict-skin top moves down 815 -> 946 -> 1054 and face center reaches y=1202, proving the focus curve uses the wrong screen-space direction.

The three new checkpoint images were not included by the legacy artifact glob, so no unuploaded frame is claimed as manually accepted.

user_device_hard_blockers: Pinch/zoom cannot currently approach Celine naturally enough for a human face/upper-body videochat close-up.
Arms and hands still read as fixed/frozen in the real production experience.
Celine still sits crooked/anatomically incoherently in CALL relative to body, legs and chair.
Blinking produces a visible wrong dark/deformed area above or around the eyes.
A video/avatar test can show controls while Celine is absent; such evidence must be a hard FAIL.
additional_product_tasks: Use the exact user-provided 2026-08-27 portrait as the source for the Yahya AI adaptive launcher icon after adding an approved repository copy; do not substitute a generated lookalike.

Audit launcher entries. Yahya AI should be the sole normal launcher icon; keep Avatar Lab reachable from Settings/developer access and move Celine 3D Import/AvatarPicker behind internal/debug/Settings access if still needed rather than exposing it as a second app.
Preserve the useful import/debug functionality until dependency audit proves it can be removed safely.
acceptance_summary: Continuous camera/dolly zoom from normal CALL framing to head-and-shoulders and real face close-up without avatar scaling, clipping or snapping.
Celine remains visibly present in HOME, CALL and production-equivalent proof/video paths; blank/offscreen/controls-only/synthetic evidence fails closed.
Stable room/root/seat anchoring with believable pelvis/torso/thigh/knee/foot/chair relationship and eased HOME/CALL transitions.
One central layered presence owner prevents pose, breathing, arm/hand, gaze/head and face/viseme systems from overwriting each other.
Visible bounded breathing, posture variation, asynchronous arm/hand life and restrained speech gestures; frozen arms fail.
Natural gaze, small eye saccades, gentle head/neck response and variable blink cadence.
Clean eyelid-only open/partial/closed/reopen behavior with no dark band or unrelated face/hair deformation.
Existing PCM-driven German lip sync remains synchronized and coexists with blink/gaze/body motion.
Lifecycle/keyboard/background/foreground/zoom/reset transitions do not lose, freeze or rescale Celine.
Final exact-head and exact-main acceptance includes manually inspected continuous production-equivalent video; still screenshots and green CI alone are insufficient.
active.current_blocker: The corrected focus direction compiles, but no post-correction production CALL frames have been inspected. The #224 artifact glob also omitted the three new checkpoints.
active.exact_next_action: Add the new production CALL normal/head/face images to the canonical Real Candidate artifact, keep peak-row growth/centering/clipping checks while removing the invalid total-skin-growth assumption, then run exactly one corrected Real Candidate proof and manually inspect all three frames.
constraints: Strict single-flight: one v80 branch and one PR only.

Workflow SUCCESS is not visual PASS; inspect actual evidence.

block1_audit_evidence.reason: The unbounded WRAP_CONTENT control panel covers the full Avatar Lab render viewport. Workflow success therefore did not constitute visual pass.

completed_blocks.note: Celine visible in HOME, CALL, user-facing Avatar Lab and HOME return; controls-only and panel-free blank evidence fail closed. This is not overall v80 acceptance.

findings: Production pinch is a real cameraZoom/dolly and one-finger avatar translation is blocked.
The legacy v70 production guard clamps zoom to 1.25 and its proof requires feet to remain visible, which contradicts v80 face-close acceptance.
Production cameraPanY remains at the body/room center while zooming; the historical 2.20 crop therefore lost/clipped the face instead of following it.
The previous real-candidate-face-close image is a derived crop, not proof of production camera zoom.
block2_audit.bounded_first_fix: Replace only the legacy production max/focus behavior with a guarded v80 CALL default and a zoom-dependent face/upper-torso camera target; leave interpolation and temporal gesture proof as subsequent block-2 work.

completed.note: Historical release completion remains true. A later real-device user video exposed combined production-experience defects; those are hard blockers for the queued v80 acceptance and override any assumption that isolated v79 lab proofs proved full human-videochat realism.
